summary.text: Anthony Bonna is the Republican candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 85, in the November 3, 2026 general election; he is a small business owner who has served on the Port St. Lucie City Council.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he named affordability, accountable government and constitutional liberties among his campaign priorities.

paragraphs.text: Bonna graduated from St. Lucie West Centennial High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Georgetown University in 2009.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he earned a finance degree there and returned home to build his career, and that he has owned and operated Good Help Group, a local marketing and communications company, since 2011.

According to his survey responses, Bonna was appointed to the St. Lucie County Commission by Governor Rick Scott in 2018, was elected to the Port St. Lucie City Council in December 2021, and was re-elected in 2022.
He also said he has served as a Big Brothers Big Sisters board member, a Rotarian for more than a decade and Chair of the Education Foundation.

Bonna said in the survey that affordability is his top priority, along with reducing waste, opposing unnecessary taxes, fees and regulations, supporting small businesses and keeping government accountable.
He also listed support for law enforcement and first responders, school choice and parental rights among his positions.
